Bug surface: REDUCED — telemetry-ownership and panel-route dispatch each collapsed to one table (K8); 4 frontmatter parsers → 1 and the entire pre-v6 migration lineage deleted (K10); K11 adds zero code, leaves two bugs with a stated non-silent disposition; two standalone bugs each fixed at a one-line root cause with a pinning regression test, LOC-neutral, zero new deciders.

CLOSURE: rc-1 PR #226 open on the trio-approved commit; memory update T-051-25 and closure narrative T-051-26 begin (local until the PR merges).

0.5.1 "deepening simplification K1-K11" gave every cross-cutting fact exactly one deep module and deleted the shallow deciders it replaced, with no observable contract change outside the twelve picked bugs. core.invocation.resolve returns one Invocation (root, session, context, repo slug, specs dir, mode, release, phase) per process and core.session_store owns the session record, collapsing eight context ladders, three sid ladders and four staleness predicates; presence.gc became the sole reaper of records, markers, sentinels and emptied directories; features/chokepoints split into branch_policy/pre_commit/push_gate/verdict with covering_verdict as the one verdict reader; BugRecord.resolve/supersede/defer/reject made a terminal status unreachable without its evidence and RecordStore.scan the one ledger parser, with the backlog's four checkers collapsed onto one; infrastructure/projection.py's ProjectionRule table plus projection_rules() made install, doctor and the install ledger three folds over one set behind a real three-adapter HarnessProjection seam; features/specs/canon.py's CANON table made scaffold canon rendered and doctor canon checked; core/handoff_index.py became the only handoff reader, router and artifact resolver; features/telemetry/store.py's TelemetryStore took ownership of the user-global SQLite connection and the panel gained one route table; the container lost its dead lifecycle closures and the entire pre-v6 migration lineage plus the duplicate catalog script were deleted, leaving "stamp v6 or refuse". CONTEXT.md landed first as the naming authority (FR-11) and every deepened module is named from it. Publication stays withheld per R9: no tag, no PyPI, no release.yml approval.

Measured at T-051-21 (3741be8f) against the T-051-02 baseline (b7fd1c22), captured under .dadaia/tmp/software-engineer/20260828/T-051-21-invariants.md by an agent with a shell: production 53,065 -> 49,679 LOC (-3,386) over 281 -> 269 modules; test suite 83,000 -> 74,619 LOC with unit test files 250 -> 220; container.py 880 -> 708 LOC; import-linter suppressed edges 18 -> 14, beating A-0.3's 15 target without raising the cap; core protocols 22 -> 21, the remaining single-adapter retirement waiting on ADR 0001. Decider counts (A-0.2): context deciders 8 -> 1, sid ladders 3 -> 1, staleness predicates 4 -> 1, GC authorities 4 -> 1, canon definitions 3 -> 1, bug-ledger parsers 4 -> 1, handoff readers 10 -> 1, frontmatter parsers 4 -> 1 with _FRONTMATTER_RE copies 7 -> 1, projection compare semantics 5 -> 1. Four raw grep counts read above 1 and are dispositioned in the invariants file by code-reviewer H2: context_deciders=3 counted a one-line delegate plus two root-only resolvers (ci's env rung deleted in the rc round), gc_reapers=4 counted a CLI verb and two private lanes behind the one public presence.gc, frontmatter_parsers=2 counted public/scripts/lint-dadaia-cli-reachability.py's persona regex block extractor, canon_tables=3 counted the one CANON tuple and its two consumers, bug_parsers=3 counted the store's line parser and two call sites reading through it. Whole-release production diff is net-negative; the K5 arc alone finished at +84 (cbacc99b +383, 3741be8f -299), flagged INFO by qa, every HIGH finding closed.

Memory updated to current truth in nine files. ARCHITECTURE.md: Part 2 gained a one-decider-per-fact table naming core/invocation.py, core/session_store.py, presence.gc, features/specs/canon.py, ProjectionRule/projection_rules, the bug transition methods, core/handoff_index.py, the four chokepoints modules, TelemetryStore and core/frontmatter.py, plus the statements that container.py is wiring only and features/migrate stamps v6 or refuses; the features package map dropped the deleted spec_artifacts package (24 -> 23) and the reports submodule node dropped validation; the SpecsDoctor diagram's notes now read the ProcessRunner port, the injected bug store and MEM-DRIFT-1; the panel views diagram gained render_api_agent_sessions and the agent_policy renders and names handler._ROUTES as the one route table. P-13's Measured-by moved from the deleted push-gated contract test tests/contract/test_architecture_diagrams_current.py to specs doctor rule MEM-DRIFT-1 (features/specs/doctor_memory.py), a WARNING per stale or missing package - the diagram-vs-code guard survives on a non-gating tier so a package added mid-implementation is closure work, not a red build. QUALITY.md: the PYTHONPATH pinned once in tests/conftest.py, the ratchets' single enumeration through tests/helpers/suite_files.tracked_test_files, and the memory-drift-is-a-WARNING rule; the ignore-edge number is deliberately NOT restated, its one home being the contract test (memory AGENTS.md, one number per parameter). TECHSTACK.md needed no change: SPEC A-9.1 was amended in flight, features/repos and openpyxl stayed for two live consumers, so the dependency list was already true. Atoms: context-management (Invocation, session_store, target-path-first root walk, presence.gc), sdd-gate-v3 (the gate builds one Invocation; the four chokepoints modules; no GC verb), sdd-bug-backlog-governance (nine bugs verbs including resolve/supersede/defer/reject, one ledger parser, transitions carry their evidence, one backlog checker, the full closure-log kind vocabulary), specs-doctor (the CANON table, MEM-DRIFT-1, SPEC-DOC-033 ERROR-only through the injected store), public-asset-distribution (ProjectionRule table, three-adapter seam, renderer-is-verifier, codex TOML byte-compared), agent-comms (HandoffIndex replaces the deleted ValidatorPort), agent-monitoring (TelemetryStore ownership, quarantine, presence.gc), panel (one route table, view isolation). Bug memory-trio-missing-required-frontmatter-fields: the atom half needed no edit - ARCHITECTURE.md, QUALITY.md and TECHSTACK.md each already carry exactly the six required fields slug/title/category/tldr/summary/tags, and T-051-16 aligned memory-frontmatter-v1 to that set, so the record is satisfied end to end and only its ledger line remains to be closed by an agent with the bugs write set. NOT changed and still drifting: P-01, P-08 and P-09 carry ADR 0001 and ADR 0003 at status proposed, so their Part-1 text travels with the operator's accept commit and was left byte-identical (P-09 still names core.specs_resolver.resolve_context, a module this release deleted); P-14 and P-15 name core/release_events.py and tests/contract/test_release_events_read_only.py / test_release_event_schema.py, all three retired at 0.5.0 when RELEASE.jsonl became RELEASE.json, and P-13's statement still claims diagrammed classes and view modules are introspected when MEM-DRIFT-1 covers feature packages only - each needs its own ADR before the sentence may move.

Twelve bugs were picked at definition; three remain open by ruling, each with a stated reason and none silently dropped. concurrent-sessions-share-git-index-commit-boundary-contamination and concurrent-agent-git-add-clobbers-other-sessions-staged-files-into-unrelated-commit stay open under ADR 0002 (status proposed): the shared git index is a git contract, not a library contract, both coded options grow a feature, and no agent flips a decision to accepted - if the operator accepts, the practice statement lands and both records go terminal deferred naming it. memory-trio-missing-required-frontmatter-fields is satisfied here: the checker half landed in T-051-16 and the trio's own frontmatter verified as exactly the six canonical fields at this closure, leaving only the BUGS.jsonl resolve line, which this session could not write - specs/bugs was outside the write set it was dispatched with. bug-record-write-once-evidence-fields-can-embed-selfscan-triggering-literal and radon-undercounts-nested-class-in-function-complexity-vs-ruff-c901 are superseded_by deepening-simplification-k1-k11; the other seven were fixed in-task with a RED case each. SPEC amendment recorded: A-9.1 required features/repos, ExcelReader and openpyxl to be deleted; the package has two live consumers, so it was kept and only the container's dead lifecycle closures went - the SPEC line is superseded by this record, and TECHSTACK.md's dependency list is correct as written. Residuals compiled for the project-manager's operator-facing intake report, with no backlog entry created here: K5's D9 (core/models/bugs.py still restates _EVIDENCE_DIFF_PATTERN_RE/_DIFF_DIRECTIONS/_STATUS_VALUES alongside the injected validator) and D12 (bug-record-v1.schema.json's cause description unchanged), both non-blocking per the re-verdict; the frontmatter-shaped regex block extractor in public/scripts/lint-dadaia-cli-reachability.py, an ai-engineer surface the invariants sweep counted as a second parser; the reported-and-open bug memory-product-add-writes-a-flat-atom-path, which belongs to the next lane; and the Part-1 ADRs the memory drift entry names - 0001 and 0003 awaiting the operator, plus new proposals owed for P-13, P-14 and P-15.

DELETE as consumed coordination, their content already transcribed into this log or superseded by a later verdict on the same subject: 2026-08-29T195915Z-qa-engineer-0.5.1-rc1-final (superseded by the 203220Z correction, as its own implemented entry states), 2026-08-29T203000Z-code-reviewer-0.5.1-rc1-six-axis (superseded by the 224500Z reverdict), and 2026-08-28T202957Z-security-reviewer-0.5.1-pr-verdict-c807e0cd (the definition-PR head verdict, already consumed by that merge). OUT OF SCOPE, left untouched and referred to their owning release: 2026-08-28T183600Z-qa-engineer-rc1-050-qa-close and 2026-08-28T013036Z-qa-engineer-T-045-36-rc1-exercise.
